Author: simi150500
Content:
This is the thing: for event-based ADC, you have different metrics. You can not really define a "general" sample rate and resolution since it depends on the input signal and its instantaneous slope.
See here: https://www.researchgate.net/publication/396348843_Event-Based_ADCs_vs_Nyquist_ADCs_Rethinking_Performance_Metrics
